frames.primary: A live government recognition application, one of the brief's goals now, has moved into examination; the next word is the examiner's, and your part is to be ready to answer any query fast.
rivals: A routine automated status notice that needs nothing from the founder until the examination ends.
The start of a query cycle in which the examiner asks for more before deciding.

expected_vs_actual.expected: With no playbook, from the brief and the notice: once an application is under examination, the portal decides and writes again when the examination completes, and the applicant answers any query it raises.
expected_vs_actual.actual: The application has moved to Under Examination; no query and no decision has arrived, and we have not written in this file.

scenarios.do_nothing: The examination runs its course and the portal writes when it completes; the risk is a query that arrives and goes unseen among automated mail.
scenarios.act: A look at the portal now confirms the stage, shows any query already raised, and leaves the founder ready to answer the examiner the same day.
scenarios.best: The examination completes without a query and the portal writes with its decision.
scenarios.worst: A query from the examiner goes unseen and the application stalls while the founder believes it is moving.
signals_to_watch: Any mail from StartupSetu asking for a document or a clarification
A change of status on the portal
Silence well past what the portal says an examination takes, once that is known

reasons: The brief names StartupSetu recognition for Nimbus Labs Private Limited as a goal now.
The notice asks nothing of the founder and says word will come when the examination completes.
Looking at the portal commits the founder to nothing, so a wrong move here costs little.

next_move.what: Sign in to the StartupSetu portal, confirm the application reads Under Examination, and note any query or document request the examiner has raised

parsed.alternative: Have every StartupSetu mail flagged the day it arrives, so a query is answered within its window.
parsed.wait_or_stop: After the check, wait for the examiner's word; stop waiting and chase StartupSetu only if a query is found, or if silence runs well past what the portal says an examination takes.
parsed.done_when: You know whether the examiner wants anything, and the application's next notice, a query or a decision, is caught the day it arrives.
